Interested candidates with strong inclination towards research and development may attend walk-
in interview proposed on 6th October, 2022 at 11 AM at Meeting Hall (Ground Floor), Centre for
Academics, CSJM University Campus. The candidates should present themselves before the
interview board with filled application form, all original documents, and 3- sets of self- attested
photocopies of all relevant marksheets and certificates.
Note:
1. No TA/DA is admissible for appearance in the interview.
2. The terms and conditions for the appointment of Project assistants would be as per regulations mentioned by
UPHEC and CSJM University, Kanpur.
